subject.title: Recover interrupted and unfinished local-model turns

question: Should embedded runs ever automatically continue after a failed tool without a generic tool-level idempotency or no-side-effect contract?
rationale: The proposed fixed tool-name list cannot establish whether arbitrary core, exec, or plugin tools may have completed an external action before reporting failure; choosing the permanent continuation contract requires owner intent.

options.title: Require a generic safe-to-retry contract
options.body: Continue only when the tool runtime explicitly records that the failed call had no external effect or is idempotent; this is the recommended safe default.

options.title: Keep the current name allowlist
options.body: Accept that unknown and exec-like tools may be resumed after ambiguous failures, with potential duplicate or compounded actions.

options.title: Do not continue tool failures
options.body: Preserve the existing terminal-error behavior for failed tools and limit this PR to transport and finalization recovery.

recommendation.title: Require a generic safe-to-retry contract
recommendation.body: Continue only when the tool runtime explicitly records that the failed call had no external effect or is idempotent; this is the recommended safe default.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the proposed continuation policy and can clarify the intended tool-effect contract before an area owner adopts it.
